subject: Fix Index/HeadTail proto_to_core_fir to unwrap brane results
description: When Index/HeadTail resolves to a brane, proto_to_core_fir currently only unwraps if the result is CONSTANT/INDEPENDENT. Should also unwrap for any settled state (NK, WOCONSTANIC, etc.) to match UBC behavior. Fixes: nested_brane_boundary, seek_across_nested_brane_boundary, offset_access_empty_brane
